profile.summary: Digital marketing executive running Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns for D2C brands.

bullets: Ran Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns with a monthly budget of Rs 12 lakh for 3 skincare brands.
Cut cost per acquisition from Rs 640 to Rs 410 by restructuring ad sets and testing 25 creatives.
Built weekly ROAS reports in Google Analytics and Excel for the founders.
Wrote 40 SEO blog posts and grew organic sessions from 8,000 to 21,000 a month.

jd.title: Performance Marketing Manager
jd.text: We are hiring a Performance Marketing Manager to own paid acquisition across Google Ads and Meta Ads. You will manage budgets, optimise CPA and ROAS, run creative testing, build dashboards and report to leadership. 3+ years of performance marketing experience required. Experience with marketing automation, CRM and attribution tools is a plus.
